"""Imports the namespace package itself.

``metrics.dependencies._is_internal_target`` admits the target because it
is a ``package_prefixes`` node, so the producer emits the edge; the module
registry has no file-bearing entry for ``nsp`` because a namespace package
owns no ``__init__.py``.
"""

from nsp import leaf


def use_leaf() -> int:
    return leaf.leaf_value()
